mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, DEPT_ID, LOG_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, ROLE, PHONE_NUMBER, GENDER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, LOGTIME_AT, BIRTH, COMMUNITY_NICKNAME FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, DEPT_ID, LOG_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NAME, ROLE, PHONE_NUMBER, GENDER, STATUS, CREATED_AT, LOGTIME_AT, BIRTH, COMMUNITY_NICKNAME ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{deptId}, #{logId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{role}, #{phoneNumber}, #{gender}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{birth}, #{communityNickname} )
